description: This file contains shell functions related to platform image verification and upgrade processes for a specific board in an OpenWrt environment. It defines functions to check the image and perform the upgrade, using the board name to determine behavior.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the platform's board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on the platform's board.
